question: A sum of Rs. 8,500 amounts to Rs. 11,900 in 5 years at simple interest per annum. If the rate of interest is increased by 3%, then the increased amount for the same period is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**The rate is increased by 3% and the given time is 5 years.

The new amount = Previous amount + [(3 × 5)% of 8500]

⇒ 11900 + 1275

⇒ Rs. 13,175

**∴ The increased amount is Rs. 13,175.**

**Traditional method:**

**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 8500

Amount = Rs. 11900

Time = 5 years

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

SI = A – P

**Calculation:**

According to the question

SI = A – P

⇒ SI = Rs. (11900 – 8500) = Rs. 3400

Now,

SI = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ Rs. 3400 = (8500 × R × 5)/100

⇒ R = (680/85)

⇒ R = 8%

Now,

The rate of interest is increased by 3% = (8 + 3)% = 11%

SI = Rs. (8500 × 11 × 5)/100

⇒ SI = Rs. 4675

Now,

A = P + SI

⇒ Rs. (8500 + 4675)

⇒ Rs. 13175

**∴ The required amount is Rs. 13,175**
